subject.title: fix(openai): retry transient Codex device polling failures

question: Should this external OAuth-flow change wait for redacted after-fix real device-login proof before merge?
rationale: Focused mocks exercise the classification logic, but only a real run can demonstrate that the interactive browser session remains usable after a transport or temporary HTTP failure.

options.title: Require real login proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, runtime log, or recording that shows a transient poll failure followed by successful completion in the same device-code session.

options.title: Accept mocked coverage only
options.body: Merge based on the focused tests while accepting that real provider and network behavior was not demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Require real login proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, runtime log, or recording that shows a transient poll failure followed by successful completion in the same device-code session.
